items.excerpt: TechRadar reviews MSI's Pro Max Edge AI+, a mini PC built for local AI with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and a 50-TOPS NPU, praising its offline AI performance.
Pre-orders are now live for Nvidia RTX Spark laptops starting at $2,599; TechRadar picks three Blackwell-powered machines for running local AI.

items.excerpt: Dell, Microsoft and others are launching laptops built on Nvidia's RTX Spark superchip, opening a 'personal AI supercomputer' laptop category that challenges Intel's x86 dominance.

items.excerpt: Motorola Razr Ultra 2026 owners are receiving Android 17, which adds a programmable AI key, themed icons and enhanced security to the clamshell foldable.
Windows Central reviews the Razer Basilisk V4 Pro: still a top gaming mouse, but it ships with an out-of-the-box AI button binding the reviewer says nobody asked for.
An XDA writer runs an entire AI workflow on local hardware for a week, reporting surprising wins and frustrating limits that show what still needs the cloud.
Humanoid robot demos still fail to generalize to real homes and workplaces; The Robot Report argues better data and human judgment are needed to move beyond staged demos.
A year living with Alexa Plus across Echo Show, Dot and Max: Amazon's generative-AI assistant is better at running the smart home, but not yet ready to run your life - and it now comes with ads.
